user.title: Tuya Doorbell RTSP
user.description: Sign in with your Tuya / Smart Life account. Only cloud signalling is used; the media prefers your LAN and stays local when Home Assistant is on the same network as the doorbell.

data_description.device_ip: Local IP of the doorbell on your LAN, e.g. 192.168.1.50. Needed only for button / datapoint events; leave empty to skip them (auto-discovery does not work from a container).

error.auth_failed: Login failed. Check email, password and country code.
error.no_cameras: No cameras found on this account.
